scope: One new right-hand whole-phrase fit, combined with exactly unchanged previous left arrays and key/audio timelines
natural_lift: 3deg base flexion reduction from bounded current idle posture during20ms prepare; existing curved rest remains. Not a global amplitude multiplier.
contact_pressure_neighborhood: All digits±16deg base flexion and±12deg other increments around approvedR1, intersect inherited static engineering domain; not an anatomical bound
common_root_envelope: One60ms prepare and120ms release stance; sustained during adjacent notes. No per-pitch/per-note palm controls.
pressure: Existing Bernstein endpoint coefficients fit against transported real-key playable targets for every source event; strictNOTE_ON/KEY_PRESS/HOLD targets; naturalrelease not adhesion-forced
solver: One bounded scipy least_squares; existingFK/skin/keyplane and shared residual, no reconstruction of solver architecture
playable_target: Nearest playable point to approved prepared-pad XY, 1mm inner inset; optional approved active reference if that digit has one, chosen generically from task metadata, not hardcoded pitch
geometry_reporting: Finite contact neighborhood, neighbor screen and limits; no vertex-forensic labels
